summary: feat(auth): add isSyncCapable to attached clients
description:
Because:
- Settings needs to know which devices can sync before it offers to delete Sync data.
- A device registers the send-tab command only while it holds the Sync key, so the registered commands already carry this signal.

This commit:
- Derive isSyncCapable per device in @fxa/accounts/connected-services.
- Return it from GET /account/attached_clients and document it in Swagger.
- Add the field to the fxa-auth-client AttachedClient type.
- Use the real close-tab command identifier in the legacy device commands test.

Closes FXA-15005
